collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A storyteller wonders whether distant people, if they exist, have a name for Isola or for the people who live here.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a storyteller, wonders whether distant people, if they exist, have a name for Isola or for the people who live here.

choices.label: Decide What Isolans Would Want to Be Called.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children invent names like "the island of laughing fishers," and the village is pleased.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An elder says a name given by strangers would only tell what the strangers thought, not who Isolans are.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar suggests Isola may be entirely unknown to anyone else; some find this peaceful.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A teenager finds the idea lonely, and a friend sits with them for a while.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village argues happily for an evening and agrees on nothing.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A child says, "Just call us by our names," and the discussion ends there.
